_comment: Manual corrections that win over the live ESPN feed. Everything here is optional - leave blank to trust the API. Edit, commit, and push to apply.
_matches_help: Force a group-match score. Key MUST be exactly 'Home|Away' as worded in the form (see fixtures in data.js). Value is [homeGoals, awayGoals].
_groupWinners_help: Force a group's winner. Key is the group letter, value is the team name.
_rounds_help: Force the full set of teams that reached a round (used for progression points). Provide complete arrays; they replace the API for that round.
_finals_help: Champion and 3rd-place playoff winner team names; final score as 'H-A'.
